summary: 3D hot-air balloon wind puzzle over Cappadocia at sunrise, built by Claude Opus 5.5 · Gün doğumunda Kapadokya'da 3D sıcak hava balonu rüzgâr bulmacası, Claude Opus 5.5 yaptı
key_features: No rudder: burn to climb, vent to sink, and ride the wind layer that blows towards the goal
A balloon with lag: lift follows the envelope temperature seconds later; propane is limited and passengers add weight
12 flights in 3 regions (Göreme, Uçhisar, an Ihlara-like canyon) with gusts, morning fog and noon thermals
Five goal types: low pass, marker drop, photo from a given height, passenger pickup and a scored landing; 36 stars
The ?auto bot flew 12/12 flights with 36/36 stars using only burner, vent, photo and drop; one index.html, everything generated in code
